frame.converter: Each sky position at a depth drawn from the spheroid's density along its sight line (frame.spheroid).

spheroid.basis: The spheroid the volume's light is spread through (labs/nebula/models/m87/experiment.json shapePrior): a Sérsic fit to Kormendy et al.'s (2009) Table 3 profile, axis along M87's minor axis in the plane of the sky, ending at 2.8 half-light radii. Each cluster's depth is drawn from it, not measured.

meaning: Globular clusters and ultra-compact dwarfs of M87 with a measured radial velocity (Strader et al. 2011, Table 9): one dot per object at its catalogue position.

appearance.note: Presentation only: the Milky Way globular clusters' warm orange.
